_doc: Forum cell: court -> filing type -> the rules that govern THAT filing in THAT court. Deterministic; ground_pack.py resolves each to verbatim corpus text or marks NOT IN CORPUS. Add cells, never hardcode rules in prompts.

denials; averments not denied are admitted
writings relied on must be attached (i) — exhibits named but not attached
when a claim or defense is based upon a writing, the pleader shall attach a copy
verification — whether a brief asserting facts outside the record needs one
liberal construction / disregard of harmless defects — the other side will invoke it

petition_341c.why: determination of finality: trial court may enter a final order as to fewer than all claims/parties only upon an EXPRESS determination that an immediate appeal would facilitate resolution of the entire case; application for the determination within 30 days of entry; 30-day decision window

factors to be considered under subdivision (c): (1) whether there is a significant relationship between adjudicated and unadjudicated claims; (2) whether an appeal would be mooted by further developments; (3) whether the court will consider issues a second time; a partial dismissal is interlocutory absent the determination
definition of final order: disposes of all claims and all parties, or is entered as a final order pursuant to (c)
appeal by permission from an interlocutory order for which certification pursuant to Pa.R.A.P. 341(c) was denied — (a)(2); the denial / deemed denial is the predicate
opinion in support of order: if the reasons for the order do not already appear of record, the judge shall file of record at least a brief opinion of the reasons for the order
authority of trial court after appeal: may grant reconsideration only on an express order within the appeal period (b)(3); a reconsideration motion does not toll the appeal period
determination of preliminary objections: the court shall determine promptly all preliminary objections; if an issue of fact is raised the court shall consider evidence
motion defined: any application to the court for an order made in any civil action or proceeding
motion contents: caption, numbered paragraphs, relief specified, verification where facts not of record
Philadelphia motions procedure: control number, response period, assignment to the motions judge / assigned judge
modification of orders within 30 days — the court's power to amend its own order before the appeal period runs
after an appeal is taken the trial court may no longer proceed further in the matter — a premature notice of appeal from the interlocutory order risks freezing the surviving counts

motion_to_vacate.why: modification of orders: a court upon notice to the parties may modify or rescind any order within 30 days after its entry if no appeal has been taken
determination of preliminary objections: the court shall determine promptly; if an issue of fact is raised the court shall consider evidence by depositions or otherwise
grounds for preliminary objections are limited to those enumerated
denials; averments not denied are admitted; general denial = admission
contents of pleadings; writings relied on must be attached
amendment of pleadings by leave of court at any time; liberally allowed
Philadelphia motions procedure: control number, response period
reconsideration must be expressly granted within the appeal period; the motion does not toll it
the order sustaining POs on fewer than all counts is interlocutory absent an express determination
